summary: Iter 41 — Verified AI Shipment Triage / Exception Detection end-to-end (both backend + frontend). Backend pytest suite test_iter41_shipment_triage.py: 10/10 PASS covering /api/shipment-triage/exception-types (8 types incl. carrier_no_response & off_route), /scan (detects 4 active exceptions across 12 booked loads — pickup_late x3 + off_route x1 from prior manual TEST_iter41 row), /exceptions list with severity sort (critical→high→medium→low) + summary counts + is_after_hours, status filter ?status=open, booked_id filter, manual POST /exceptions (400 on bad type, 404 on bad booked_id, 200 with full advice on valid input), POST /exceptions/{id}/status persists resolved + resolved_at + resolution_notes (404 on unknown id), /dashboard returns active_count/critical_count/high_count/by_type/by_severity/mttr_hours/resolved_total/is_after_hours, and POST /ai-polish returns 200 with graceful fallback path (no 5xx — body carries ai_polished:false + note/error if AI unavailable, else advice_ai_polished text). Frontend: /triage page loads with triage-band (active=4, resolved=1, mode=AFTER HOURS badge — current UTC hour ≥18), 6 filter chips render (active/open/acknowledged/in_progress/resolved/all), 4 exception cards visible (Pickup Late HIGH x3 + Off Route MEDIUM x1), card click opens triage modal showing escalation banner (after-hours · paging on-call broker AND backup-carrier desk), AI Root Cause text, 3-step Playbook numbered list, side-by-side Customer Message + Carrier Escalation with Copy buttons, and action row (AI Polish, I'm on it, Escalate, Resolve). scan-btn POST works and toast 'All clear · no new exceptions' fires. Report dialog (manual-booking select with 13 booking options, manual-create-btn) creates an exception successfully. Sidebar nav-triage with ShieldAlert icon present. Workflow HUD /workflow Active Exceptions red panel renders with data-testid='workflow-exceptions' and hud-ex-{exception_id} per item — verified for BK-8A6CB0889E (2 exceptions: Off Route + Pickup Late) and BK-0B95A379CE (1 exception: Pickup Late HIGH), each with severity pill and 'Open AI Triage Console →' link.

issues: 'Made with Emergent' fixed badge in bottom-right overlaps the Resolve button on 1920x1080 — minor; modal action row sits just above the badge. Consider raising the modal action z-index or shifting the badge for the /triage route.

Hydration warning logged: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' on the manual-booking native <select>. Originates from Emergent's visual-editor instrumentation wrapping JSX expressions in spans (x-ve-dynamic). Functionally harmless — selection + submission both work — but emits a console error on every dialog mount. Safe fix is to replace the native <select> with a shadcn <Select> (the rest of the page already uses it) so the visual-editor span wrapper sits inside SelectItem instead of <option>.

action_items: Optional: replace native <select data-testid='manual-booking'> + native <select> for exception_type/severity in ShipmentTriage.jsx Report dialog with shadcn <Select> components to eliminate the <span> in <option> hydration warning (cosmetic only).
Optional: bump the /triage modal action row z-index above the Made-with-Emergent badge (or hide the badge inside dialogs) so Resolve isn't visually crowded on 1920x1080.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/shipment_triage.py severity sort is implemented twice: Mongo .sort([(severity,-1)]) followed by Python sort with sev_order map. The Mongo sort is redundant (and wrong because severity is a string). Keep only the Python sort; remove the Mongo .sort() to avoid confusion.

shipment_triage._is_after_hours uses UTC hour with band 18→7. This is correct as designed but worth surfacing in the UI tooltip — currently the band text 'High+ severity pages on-call after 6pm UTC' is the only indicator; ops users in PT/CT may be confused at 10am local appearing as after-hours.

dashboard MTTR computation: durs.append(d - rd) where d=hours since created_at, rd=hours since resolved_at — this yields (resolved_at - created_at) in hours, which is correct, but variable names are misleading; rename to `created_hours_ago` / `resolved_hours_ago` and compute `created_hours_ago - resolved_hours_ago` for clarity.

AI Polish path catches all exceptions and returns 200 with ai_polished:false — good for UX, but the response shape changes (no advice_ai_polished key on failure). Frontend code should defensively read `body.advice_ai_polished || body.note || body.error` to render fallback text.
Manual exception endpoint accepts any severity that matches the regex but doesn't enforce default_severity guardrail — fine, just confirm dispatchers can intentionally override.
ShipmentTriage.jsx is 469 lines — approaching the 700 line threshold but still focused. No refactor needed yet.
